name: MatchMates External API
description:
API for external integrations to create candidate profiles in MatchMates.

## Authentication

All API requests require an API key to be passed in the `X-API-Key` header. API keys can be created in the MatchMates dashboard under Company Settings > API-Schlüssel.

## Rate Limiting

Currently there are no rate limits, but this may change in the future.

## Credits

API calls may consume credits from your organization's wallet if the `create_candidate` action is configured.
